waivers.reason: Transitive through the Markdown toolchain used for documentation. The app renders no Markdown and links no user text. Advisory: LinkifyIt#match scan loop has quadratic algorithmic complexity

Reached only through the Metro bundler and Expo CLI at build time, on archives this repo produces itself. The shipped app contains no tar parser and never handles an untrusted archive. Advisory: node-tar: Decompression/parse DoS via unlimited input

Build-time only, via the Expo config plugins that generate Info.plist and AndroidManifest. The XML parsed is generated by this repo, not received from anywhere. Advisory: xmldom: Uncontrolled recursion in XML serialization leads to DoS
Used for build-time identifiers. The size argument is never attacker-controlled -- every call site passes a literal. Advisory: nanoid: custom generators can loop indefinitely when size is zero

Build-time only, via Metro. No shell command in this app is constructed from user input; the shipped bundle spawns no process at all. Advisory: shell-quote: Quadratic-complexity Denial of Service in `parse()` (CWE-407)

Reached through glob matching in the build and test tooling. Patterns come from this repo config, never from input. Advisory: brace-expansion: DoS via exponential-time expansion of consecutive non-expanding {} groups
